faq.question: How long does drying take?
faq.answer: Usually a few hours with low-moisture methods and up to a day with extraction, depending on ventilation. We advise you on the day.

faq.question: Can every stain be removed?
faq.answer: Most can be greatly improved. Some old or set-in stains, or dyes that have bled, cannot be fully removed. We tell you honestly before we start.

faq.question: Do you clean antique or hand-knotted rugs?
faq.answer: We assess each one. Some valuable or fragile rugs are better entrusted to a specialist workshop, and we will recommend one if so.
